user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate polygon boundary for State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a GeoPackage or GeoJSON polygon dataset representing the State College borough boundary. The returned candidate must be inspected at runtime for spatial coverage, CRS, geometry validity, and supported format before downstream use.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary to the known CRS of the census tracts for spatial intersection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not assign a CRS; use the candidate's observed source CRS. If the source CRS is absent or cannot be established from runtime evidence, route clarification rather than guessing.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify the census tracts whose geometries intersect the borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial intersection-based join between the known census-tract layer and the reprojected borough boundary. Retain the census-tract features that intersect the borough. Do not guess or bind attribute join keys or field names.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject intersecting tracts to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the selected tract polygons with the DEM CRS for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the selected census tracts to EPSG:3857, matching the known DEM CRS. Preserve the selected tract features and their attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation for intersecting tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize mean DEM elevation within each census tract intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the DEM as the raster and the reprojected intersecting census tracts as polygon zones. Produce the mean elevation for each tract and retain an identifier from the tract attributes when available through runtime schema evidence.
